This announcement from the US Department of Agriculture is great to hear! Millions of Americans rely on USDA nutrition programs to fight food insecurity. It's great to see USDA take steps to ensure everyone has equal access to these important programs.
https://t.co/QQ2hT35SZ7

This is a big deal. I'd urge all Vermonters who are interested to sign up for this essential discussion on reducing hunger in the United States. To join a regional listening session, click here: https://t.co/eHQthGoxVi

Across the country, Republican-backed voter suppression tactics have damaged our democracy and made it harder for folks to exercise their right to vote. 

Let's be clear: your vote is your right. You should not have to struggle to exercise it. https://t.co/9pmDdy6uTJ

The facts are clear: abortion bans put women's health and safety at risk. 

I urge my Senate colleagues to put women’s health and safety first. It's time to abolish the filibuster and pass the Women's Health Protection Act now. https://t.co/rokcT9bRb8

Across the country, student organizations like MiddVotes are helping young people register to vote and head to the polls. I’m glad to see that these students are dedicated to giving everyone the knowledge and resources to exercise their right to vote.
https://t.co/05v7kIjHzp

This story is a powerful reminder of the toll the opioid epidemic has taken on our communities. We must invest in education and treatment, from training medical professionals and addiction experts to facilitating telemedicine for substance use disorders.
https://t.co/4F3YKxTyvX

I’m glad @HHSGov is working to make its pandemic telemedicine policies permanent. 

These changes remove barriers for folks seeking treatment for substance use disorder and help Vermonters get the care they need.
https://t.co/anJza60noD

An example of our broken health care system:

-Drug companies charge sky-high prices for prescriptions.
-Insurance companies force patients to jump through hoops to avoid covering the drug.

It all amounts to worse care for patients. That needs to change.
https://t.co/9C3Kk3vHCP

I also want to note that more than 25 million people experience depression in America, yet there's still stigma surrounding it. 

Leaders like John being open and honest helps others watching them recognize their own mental health struggles and seek treatment.

187 people die from opioid overdoses every day in America. We need to get more resources to the folks who can save lives.
 
That’s why I helped pass a budget last year that increased funding for overdose prevention and substance use treatment.

Let’s get real: This isn’t about caring for children, it's not about equity in sports, it's not about religious liberty.
 
It's about discriminating against trans people for living honestly. We need federal protections for trans folks now.
https://t.co/8FcybUwuhE

What good is health care if you can't afford it?
 
One in four adults skip treatment because of the cost, which will only lead to more health issues down the line.
 
We need to bring down costs and expand programs that keep patients healthy.
https://t.co/pA8zusv4Ge

The overdose crisis is impacting families in every corner of the country.   

We can save lives by expanding access to treatment and reducing the supply of illicit drugs in America. 
https://t.co/V97fWbV6AU

In 2023, no one in America should go hungry.
 
I've introduced the Improving Access to Nutrition Act, which will cut through red tape and expand access to SNAP benefits so more folks can get the healthy food they need.   
https://t.co/yYa0wNJjAS

Congress has spent too much time on Big Ag, and too little time on nutrition, sustainable farming, and the well-being of agricultural workers.
 
I’m introducing two bills with @RepCasar today that will protect farmworkers on the job and support small farms around the country. https://t.co/QBgxnFnyGW

Our health care system is broken. I'm working to fix it by:
 
-Taking on Big Pharma to lower the cost of prescription drugs.
-Expanding telehealth so more folks in rural areas can access care.
-Increasing access to treatment and harm reduction tools to combat the overdose crisis.

We have to take action to combat the overdose crisis.
 
This funding means more resources will go toward treatment and give workers on the ground the tools they need to save lives.
https://t.co/OpCbHNLOhq

We need to make it easier for folks to get connected to the nutrition assistance programs they need, not harder.
 
I'm introducing the Streamlining Nutrition Paperwork Act with my colleagues to cut through red tape and reduce hunger in America.

Republicans have introduced a resolution allowing discrimination in nutrition assistance programs. 
 
There are 12,000 kids in Vermont facing hunger right now. We should be focused on feeding them, not discriminating against them.
 
I will vote no.

Michael Johnson spent over three years in a cell the size of a parking space without exercise.
 
Excessive use of solitary confinement is cruel, violates the Constitution, and doesn't rehabilitate individuals. Disappointing that SCOTUS ducked this case.
https://t.co/WAiN8APuuQ

Barring people who are currently or formerly incarcerated from voting weakens our democracy.

We need to pass the Inclusive Democracy Act so people can exercise their right to vote in federal elections.

Rural areas rely on EMS service to keep our communities safe. That service is being threatened by Medicare not paying for treatment that doesn't require a hospital visit.

Our delegation’s EMS ROCS Act will get EMS providers payment so they can keep serving folks in rural areas.

Residential reentry centers help incarcerated folks with housing, treatment, jobs, and they've been proven to reduce recidivism. Yet Vermont is one of only two states without one.
 
I'm pushing the @OfficialFBOP to ensure Vermont gets the resources we need. https://t.co/u3vryHv1w7

Vermont is home to many maple producers who take pride in the quality product they put on the table every night.
 
My new bill will allow seniors to buy maple syrup under the Seniors Farmers Market Nutrition Program so more folks can enjoy the delicacy. https://t.co/nCwBcJ75FB

I'm very pleased my office was able to secure $825,000 to help Fairfax upgrade their wastewater treatment facility.
 
This project is a crucial infrastructure upgrade that will make it easier for the town to grow.
https://t.co/KmVgToimrr
